title.zh: Claude Code自己给AI应用调优：改Prompt、换模型，变差就回滚
title.en: Claude Code自己给AI应用调优：改Prompt、换模型，变差就回滚

current_state.zh: Anthropic added an automated tuning loop to Claude Code's claude-api Skill that iteratively rewrites prompts, tool descriptions, model choice and reasoning effort against evals while using held-out cases to avoid overfitting, demoed on 44 support tickets where accuracy rose from 78.6% to 90.5% at about one-fifth the cost.
